---
description: Reset the demo by removing the generated model layout
---

Reset the model layout demo:

1. Delete `build/LEGO Sets 2025.SemanticModel/diagramLayout.json` if it exists.
2. Run `git restore build` to undo any other changes in the `build` folder.
3. Do not edit, create, or commit anything else.

Reply with one line: "Reset done" or the error.
